source_title: CHFJPY.triangle residual revert z>=3.0 h=8
mechanism_note: CHFJPY regressed on USDCHF + USDJPY (triangle): CHFJPY is USDCHF against USDJPY up to the cross spread; the residual is flow specific to this cross rather than to either currency. The residual is faded beyond 3.0 sigma.

source_title: EURGBP.triangle residual revert z>=2.0 h=8
mechanism_note: EURGBP regressed on EURUSD + GBPUSD (triangle): EURGBP is EURUSD against GBPUSD up to the cross spread; the residual is flow specific to this cross rather than to either currency. The residual is faded beyond 2.0 sigma.
